OPENING (B-HC8-119, agent 119) — growth-project-mobile#369 @ 35717bfe0053a3e6075f821e5763fb7a80634d51

New stack piece **H7** on #364 @ `1266038cd311f3dcfd8e472c04e3241a3061866b` (#362 has 17 lines of ceiling left; #359-#364 untouched). Lands with #359-#364 as one. Size **845** (832+/13-; 101 production, 744 test), under the 1,500 new-PR limit.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing-before -> passing-after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sol B-362-8 (Opus C-362-14) failed removal + restart resurrects grant | grants bound to the persisted consent session; sign-out replaces it in the chain before any removal (removes it when the write fails); absent/unreadable session or session-less grant = no grant; Connect starts a session when none is stored | `35717bf` | Sol `authActions.restartGrant.sol119f` getAllKeys + removeMany cases ("Expected not_authorized, Received imported" -> pass); `onDeviceState.signOutDurable` 10 cases; Opus flipped C-362-14 |
| Sol B-362-9 other cleanup rejection skips health drain | `signOut` = sync stop + epoch bump, then `try { rest } finally { await healthStateRetired }`; the parallel clear's own `finally` awaits it before `logout` | `35717bf` | Sol clearUserCache + clearAllStorage cases ("Expected false, Received true" -> pass); `authActions.healthDrainFinally` 3 cases (inside the clear, before it, control) |
| Sol C-362-13 remainder = Opus C-362-15 (same lines) | failed grant write restores the latest grant that reached disk (`authCommittedAt`) | `35717bf` | Sol `onDeviceState.failedGrantChain.sol119f` (fail -> pass, control passes both); Opus flipped C-362-15 |

Tests commit `f36bbdc` (tests only). Sol's two suites are byte-identical to `ops/aud-119/AUD-SOL-H46F-119/` (`authActions.healthQueueFailures.sol119f.test.ts` run as `authActions.restartGrant.sol119f.test.ts`, and `onDeviceState.failedGrantChain.sol119f.test.ts`).

**CI lane, 68 suites (B-HC7 top list + new suites + H46F probes):**
- Failing-before `f36bbdc` + probes: [37241679887](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37241679887), 19 fail / 774 pass. Every failure is a newly asserted invariant, plus the known superseded Sol H6-118 SAMSUNG_HEALTH expectation. No setup failures.
- Passing-after `35717bf` + probes: [37241704846](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37241704846), 790 pass / 3 fail, 66/68 suites. All 3 failures are by design: the two original Opus `DOCUMENTS C-362-14/15` cases (they assert the old behaviour; flipped copies per Opus's fix rule pass), and the Sol H6-118 `audit364.samsungRetirement` SAMSUNG_HEALTH expectation (its adapted hc4 copy passes).

**Probe replay (both lenses, after run):**
- Sol H45-118 `useWearableConnections.sol118`, `ConnectionsScreen.sol118`: pass.
- Sol H6-118 `audit364.samsungRetirement`: by-design fail (SAMSUNG_HEALTH); adapted `.hc4` copy passes.
- Sol H46 `useWearableConnections.sol119` and `transportSol119`: pass.
- Sol H46D `disconnectRetry.sol119`: pass.
- Sol H46E `authActions.healthQueue.sol119e` and `retireNativeOrder.sol119`: pass.
- Sol H46F `authActions.restartGrant.sol119f` (final suite, 4 failure cases + controls) and `onDeviceState.failedGrantChain.sol119f`: pass.
- Opus H45-118 `ConnectionsScreen.emptyImport.probe`, `WearablesShell.settingsReturn.probe`: pass.
- Opus H6-118 `ConnectionsScreen.samsungRow.opus118` and `healthConnectRationale.opus118`: pass.
- Opus H46 `useWearableConnections.opus119`, `hcPrivacyTemplate.opus119`: pass.
- Opus H46D `useWearableConnections.opus119d`: pass.
- Opus H46E `onDeviceState.opus119e`, the H46F updated copy: pass.
- Opus H46F `onDeviceState.opus119f`: 6 pass, 2 `DOCUMENTS` cases fail by design. The flipped copy passes 8/8.

**PR CI at this head:** Typecheck, lint, test success ([run 37242039750](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37242039750)). Analyze runs only on main-based PRs (stacked base), as for #359-#364.

**Money list (not a money PR; for the record):**
- Webhook order and redelivery: n/a.
- Concurrency: one serial state chain. A sign-out queued behind a native write in flight replaces the session after that write, so the write stays void. Two overlapping failed grants are covered.
- Terminal states: the deleted-account path ends in the same `signOut()`.
- Pagination and completeness: n/a. A failed enumeration still replaces the session, so it fails closed.
- Currency: n/a.
- Copy truth: no UI copy changed.

**Pre-push checks:**
- No new logging.
- The in-flight grant write does not re-check after its session read, by design. A sign-out that started meanwhile is queued behind it and replaces the session, and the in-run watermark voids the write.
- The cancellation race is covered by the in-flight test.
- No migrations, no lockfile, no native changes.

**Residual (not claimed fixed):** an old grant can still survive a restart only if the session write, the session removal and the prefix removal all reject in the same sign-out.

READY FOR AUDIT

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#369 @ 35717bfe0053a3e6075f821e5763fb7a80634d51 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/2

Independent T4 full new-piece review, AUD-SOL-H7-119, agent 119. All six changed files and health state/auth/Connect/refresh/resume/native-progress/deletion call sites reviewed; 845 changed lines is under the 1,500 new-piece ceiling. [Candidate opening](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/369#issuecomment-5985418514).

### Prior finding disposition

**B-362-9 closes in the H7 stack:** the parallel cleanup now awaits health retirement in `finally` before logout; the outer `finally` also drains on an earlier rejection. Both original cleanup-rejection cases, successful-clear controls and held-native/queued-grant controls are independently replayed; **B-362-2/6/7 remain closed**, and **C-362-13 remainder / C-362-15 closes** with committed-sequence rollback. [Independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37242785243).

**B-362-8 is narrowed but not fully closed:** session replacement repairs isolated getAllKeys/removeMany failures and the session-write-plus-prefix-removal case when the fallback removeItem succeeds, but a correlated mutation outage leaves both old session and old grant intact. Therefore the requested #362 closure condition is not met; its exact-head prior REQUEST CHANGES is not superseded. [Prior finding](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5985235823), [H7 proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37242785243).

### B-369-1 — Consent revival after one backing-store mutation outage

Promotes builder **C-369-1**; this is the residual of **B-362-8**, not a different cross-account claim. Location: `src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts:275-289` and `getLocalAuthorization:206-235`. Actual signOut completes and emits logout while `setItem(session)`, fallback `removeItem(session)` and health `removeMany` reject from the same storage outage; the in-run getter correctly returns null, but all errors are swallowed and neither stored value changes. After I/O recovers and a fresh JS lifetime, the same signed-in account with the still-connected remote row gets `imported` and one sync call without a new Connect (expected `not_authorized` and zero calls). Another account remains unauthorized, and persistence-positive/successful-revocation controls pass. [Actual-signOut failure/recovery proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37242785243).

Three API calls on the same backing store are not three independent durability boundaries; the previous requirement explicitly fails closed on uncertain invalidation. Minimal fix rule: make failed cleanup incapable of restoring consent after restart/new login, for example through a separately persisted session/revocation authority or an authenticated-session binding renewed before health work is allowed. If the authority cannot be established, keep health unauthorized until a fresh explicit Connect. Do not rely solely on another volatile retry flag; preserve ordinary same-session restart authorization, logout completion, account isolation and both original rejection probes. [Required invariant](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5985235823).

### Optional findings

- **C-369-2:** `src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts:286-287,333-363` (progress read/write outside own changed lines). A failed prefix removal plus a new explicit Connect to the same remote connection retains old completed-through/page-token state. No consent bypass is claimed once revocation works. Bind progress to the consent session or discard stale-session progress; keep same-session resume and successful-clear controls. [Independent documentation probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37242785243).
- **C-369-3:** `src/services/authActions.ts:384,460-462` (pre-existing outside this diff). An earlier throwing dependency aborts before logout; H7 now correctly drains health before propagating that rejection, but does not make logout unconditional. Ticket a resilient auth-cleanup boundary with truthful recovery, rather than moving unrelated auth behavior into this freeze repair. This is synthetic injected rejection evidence, not a claim that the production identity drain normally rejects. [Candidate held-drain controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37242785243).

### Evidence scope and operator default

Independent mobile lane **1 asserted invariant failure / 254 passing tests, 21/22 suites passing**, at execution `6ed0ba3379a59c30404cb5b215c7de2f1835f513` = exact candidate + test-only `7466fb3` + targeted workflow; no candidate production edits. Both requested H46F probe versions, candidate repair suites and auth/state/session/deletion/hooks/native-sync controls run there. Builder before/after logs separately confirm 19 failures before / 790 passes and only three documented obsolete expectations after; the flipped Opus expectations agree with the implemented partial repairs. [Independent lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37242785243), [Builder before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37241679887), [Builder after](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37241704846).

G09 reuse applies only to unchanged previously reviewed H1-H6 source and prior closed boundaries; every H7 line was reviewed independently, not adopted from the other lens. Ordinary exact-head Typecheck/lint/test is green, Analyze absent on the stacked base. Default: **repair B-369-1, do not downgrade the uncertain-revocation residual; ticket C-369-2/3; keep H1-H7 land-as-one, main-based required checks and separately authorized native/device/privacy/flag release gates**. No device, real health-data upload, build, deployment or production acceptance claim. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37242039750/job/111552537707).

FIX ROUND 1 (B-HC9-119, agent 119) — growth-project-mobile#369 @ 3252ec79cd9ab1f28165a1913d8ae3096b590d4a

Answers the Sol REQUEST CHANGES 0/1/2 at `35717bfe0053a3e6075f821e5763fb7a80634d51` ([verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/369#issuecomment-5985494019)). No Opus verdict exists on #369 yet. #359-#364 untouched. Size 1,205 changed lines (1,191+/14-; 156 production, 1,049 test), under the 1,500 new-PR limit; this round adds 378 (73 production, 305 test). Fast-forward push on the PR branch (no force push).

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (failing before -> passing after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sol B-369-1** (= builder C-369-1, the B-362-8 remainder): one AsyncStorage mutation outage at sign-out leaves the session and grant unchanged; after a restart the same account syncs without a new Connect | `onDeviceState.ts`: every grant is also bound to a consent authority in **SecureStore** (`wearables_on_device_authority`, Keychain / Keystore, random nonce), outside the AsyncStorage backing store. `retireOnDeviceStateAtSignOut()` revokes it **at once** and **again first in the storage chain** (a grant write in flight may have started a new one), before any AsyncStorage write; a failed delete writes a new random value (also voids every grant). `getLocalAuthorization` needs both session and authority to match; absent, unreadable or missing authority = no grant. Connect starts an authority when none is stored; a failed authority read or write rejects the grant write. `retireOnDeviceState()` (no source) revokes it too | `3252ec7` (fix), `414b36a` (tests only) | Sol's exact probe `authActions.storageOutage.sol119g` (byte-identical, now in the PR, replacing its subset `restartGrant.sol119f`): "one AsyncStorage mutation outage ..." FAIL before (`{kind: imported, syncCalls: 1}`) -> PASS after (`not_authorized`, 0 calls), every other case unchanged and green. New `onDeviceState.authorityStore` (9 cases): 8 FAIL before -> PASS after, 1 control PASS both |
| C on the same lines (hardening) | `getLocalAuthorization` returns null when a sign-out started during its reads | `3252ec7` | authorityStore "a sign-out that starts while a grant is being read returns no grant" FAIL -> PASS |
| C-369-2 (progress bound to consent session) | Not changed: `getSyncProgress` / `setSyncProgress` (onDeviceState.ts:386-416) are not on the B-369-1 lines. Ticket | - | Sol's `progressSession.sol119g` documentation case and control PASS before and after |
| C-369-3 (early throw skips logout, authActions.ts) | Out of scope under freeze. Ticket | - | - |

Mutation check (local): removing the in-chain second revocation makes "a grant write in flight that starts a new authority after the first revocation is revoked again in the chain" fail, so both revocations are load-bearing.

### CI lane (72 suites: this PR's suites, both lenses' H45-H46F probes from probe commit `cb96572`, the H7 PR's old `restartGrant.sol119f`, Sol's H7 `restartOriginal.sol119f` and `progressSession.sol119g`)
- Failing before at `414b36a` (tests only, no fix): [run 37244032480](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37244032480): 12 fail / 814 pass. The 9 new assertions (Sol outage case + 8 authorityStore) plus the 3 by-design failures below.
- Passing after at `3252ec7`: [run 37244045034](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37244045034): 823 pass / 3 fail, all by design and identical to the opening's after run: the 2 original Opus H46F DOCUMENTS cases C-362-14/15 (their flipped copy `onDeviceState.opus119f.flipped` PASSES) and Sol H6-118 `audit364.samsungRetirement` SAMSUNG_HEALTH (the adapted `.hc4` copy PASSES).

### Probe replay (both lenses), at `3252ec7`
| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| Sol H7 `authActions.storageOutage.sol119g` (all 14 cases) | PASS (was 1 fail) |
| Sol H7 `authActions.restartOriginal.sol119f` | PASS |
| Sol H7 `onDeviceState.progressSession.sol119g` | PASS (documents C-369-2) |
| Sol H46F `authActions.restartGrant.sol119f` (opening copy) | PASS |

| Sol H45/H6-118 `useWearableConnections.sol118`, `ConnectionsScreen.sol118`, `audit364.samsungRetirement.hc4` | PASS |
| Sol H6-118 `audit364.samsungRetirement` (original) | FAIL by design (SAMSUNG_HEALTH retired by H6; `.hc4` copy passes) |
| Opus H46F `onDeviceState.opus119f` DOCUMENTS C-362-14/15 | FAIL by design (documented old behaviour; `opus119f.flipped` passes) |
| Opus H46E `onDeviceState.opus119e`, H46/H46D `useWearableConnections.opus119`/`opus119d`, `hcPrivacyTemplate.opus119` | PASS |
| Opus H45/H6-118 `ConnectionsScreen.emptyImport.probe`, `WearablesShell.settingsReturn.probe`, `ConnectionsScreen.samsungRow.opus118`, `healthConnectRationale.opus118` | PASS |
| B-HC8 suites `onDeviceState.signOutDurable`, `authActions.healthDrainFinally`, `onDeviceState.signOutDrain`, `serialQueue`, `sessionFence`, `onDeviceSync`, auth/sign-out/deletion/hook/native-sync suites | PASS |

### Money list (self-check; this PR moves no money)
- Webhook order and redelivery: N/A (no webhook or server write; local consent state only).
- Concurrency (two workers, lock order): one serial storage chain; sign-out bumps the epoch synchronously, revokes the SecureStore authority at once, then in the chain after the native op in flight: authority again -> session -> prefix removal. A grant write in flight is void by the in-run watermark and by the second revocation (tested).
- Terminal states: sign-out and account deletion (ends in the same `signOut()`) revoke consent; a deleted or signed-out account's grant never authorizes again after a restart, even with every AsyncStorage mutation failing.
- List pagination and completeness: fail closed: a failed `getAllKeys` still revokes authority and session; nothing is honoured on incomplete state.
- Currency: N/A.
- Copy truth: no user-facing copy changed; the PR body residual is rewritten to state exactly what remains (both SecureStore writes AND all AsyncStorage mutations failing in one sign-out).

### Pre-push checklist
No free-form text reaches logs or Sentry (the new code logs nothing; the authority is a random nonce, nothing personal). Every await before a returned grant is followed by an epoch re-check. Cancellation races covered (in-flight write, held native write and app exit, sign-out during a read). No copy changes. Upgrade: the stack is not on main, so no stored grants predate the binding; iOS Keychain keeps the nonce across a reinstall, which is harmless (the grants are gone with AsyncStorage).

Residual (not claimed fixed): an old grant returns after a restart only if, in one sign-out, SecureStore rejects both the delete and the replacement write AND AsyncStorage rejects all three mutations. Follow-up for the operator: `src/services/secureStorage.ts:99-103` swallows a failed token delete at sign-out (outside this diff, pre-existing).

PR CI at this exact head: Typecheck, lint, test **success**, [run 37244309360](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37244309360/job/111559038041). Analyze is absent on the stacked base (as for H1-H6); main-based required checks run when the stack lands.

Next: fresh Opus lens and fresh Sol lens at `3252ec79cd9ab1f28165a1913d8ae3096b590d4a`. H1-H7 land as one.
